title: Partner Mode v1 rollout
problem_statement: Execution quality and autonomy standards exist in docs but are not consistently enforced with structured evidence and quality gates.
objective: Implement Partner Mode v1 baseline with enforced change-control records and verification bundles to reduce micromanagement and increase trust.

failure_points: Changes shipped without structured impact analysis
No single record tying decision rationale + guardrails
current_state.blast_radius: Low-medium: adds scripts/docs and tracking files only; no core config mutation.

options_considered.tradeoffs: Powerful but high complexity and rollout risk

selected_solution.rationale: Best-fit path to immediate behavior change without risky architectural churn; creates auditable habits first, then scale.

guardrails.retry_backoff: For operational jobs, keep existing exponential backoff patterns; no aggressive retry loops added.
guardrails.fallback: If verification bundle generation fails, keep change in in_progress and do not mark complete.
guardrails.rollback: Remove added scripts/docs and revert change record to prior commit.

restart.reason: No gateway config/apply changes were made.

completion.summary: Phase 1 implemented: change-control-lite + verification-bundle scripts, partner mode v1 plan documented. Ready for Phase 2 hard-gating integration.
